title: Nil–Three at Half-Time. Then This. | Zrinjski 4–3 AZ Alkmaar
description:
On 21 September 2023, Zrinjski Mostar played the first European group-stage match in the history of Bosnia and Herzegovina's clubs. At half-time they were 0–3 down to AZ Alkmaar, semi-finalists of the competition the season before. Then Krunoslav Rendulić sent on Zvonimir Kožulj.

This is the story of the forty-five minutes that followed — told from the stand under the White Hill, with a supporter's own photos and clips from that night, the words of both coaches, and what the papers wrote the morning after.
